impact.attacker_capability: A local process able to create AF_UNIX sockets and pass file descriptors can trigger the affected garbage-collection state transition; the supplied evidence does not establish code execution or privilege escalation.
impact.security_effect: Local kernel availability failure (page fault and panic).

causal_trace.summary: A local process can construct an AF_UNIX descriptor-passing topology containing a listening socket and socketpair endpoints, then close its descriptors.

Before the fix, unp_gc applied socantrcvmore() and unp_dispose() to each collected socket without excluding listening sockets, although the fix commit states those functions assume initialized socket buffers and listeners lack that initialization.
The observed kernel stack shows unp_gc() calling socantrcvmore(), then sorwakeup_locked(), before faulting in __mtx_lock_flags().
The recorded outcome is a supervisor read page fault and kernel panic in taskqueue context.

primary_invariant.statement: Receive-side cleanup operations used by AF_UNIX garbage collection must only run on socket states whose socket buffers are initialized; listening sockets must be excluded.
primary_invariant.violated_because: unp_gc previously invoked socantrcvmore() and unp_dispose() for a collected listening socket. The maintainer patch identifies their initialized-buffer assumption, while post-fix unp_dispose() asserts that its argument is not a listening socket.

quality.review_notes: Primary crash, maintainer fix diff, post-fix source, and committed regression-test artifacts were inspected. The test establishes a regression input contract but the bundle has no test-run output or standalone harness invocation. The supplied source snapshot is post-fix, so the exact pre-fix surrounding source was not independently inspected. No evidence supports impact beyond local kernel availability.

remediation.invariant_restored: unp_gc skips socantrcvmore() and unp_dispose() when SOLISTENING(so) is true, preventing receive-side cleanup from operating on listening sockets whose socket buffers are not initialized.

state_context.attacker_state_setup: Create/bind/listen on an AF_UNIX stream socket, create a stream socketpair, send the listener and each endpoint through one endpoint, and close the original descriptors.
data_structure_invariants: socantrcvmore() and unp_dispose() require initialized socket buffers.
unp_dispose() asserts that its socket argument is not SOLISTENING.
unp_gc must not apply these receive-side cleanup operations to a listening socket.
state_context.state_machine: An AF_UNIX stream socket transitions to listening state; its descriptor is transferred with socketpair descriptors and later processed by AF_UNIX garbage collection. The vulnerable cleanup path treated this listening state as eligible for receive-side cleanup.

affected_versions_or_commits.value: Revisions before fix commit 9d9fa9a2c22f67d5f8afec18106c9f0072d6b3d4; the supplied bundle does not establish an earlier introduction boundary.

oracle.expected_negative: The test source contains no explicit crash assertion or supplied vulnerable-build execution result; the historical negative oracle is the syzbot-recorded kernel page fault and panic.
oracle.expected_positive: On a fixed build, the listening_socket test constructs the AF_UNIX listener/socketpair descriptor-passing sequence and closes the descriptors without violating its explicit setup assertions.
